app.name: VectolynCloud
lang.label: Language
nav.label: Main navigation
start.title: Panel
start.lede: Manage the cloud and the network of this node in the browser.
start.unreachable-long: The panel server does not answer. Check that the node is running and that the panel is switched on in config/panel.yml.
password.rules: 12 to 256 characters, not your user name. A sentence of several words is easy to remember.
password.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
setup.title: Create the first account
setup.lede: No one has an account on this panel yet. The node printed a one-time setup token in its console (or run "api token setup" there for a new one). With it you create the owner account, which has every right.
setup.token-hint: Starts with vcs_. It works once and expires after 24 hours.
setup.name: User name
setup.name-hint: Optional. Without one, the name stored with the token is used. Letters, digits, _ . and -, at most 32 characters.
login.title: Sign in
login.name: User name
login.totp-lede: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
account.title: My account
account.password-changed: The password is changed. Other sessions of this account are signed out.
account.totp-state-on: On: every sign-in with the password also asks for a code.
account.totp-state-off: Off. With an authenticator app, a stolen password is not enough to sign in.
account.totp-scan: Add this account to your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
account.totp-secret: Or type the key by hand:
account.totp-on: The authenticator app is switched on.
account.totp-off: The authenticator app is switched off.
account.passkeys-none: No passkey yet. A passkey signs you in with the fingerprint, face or PIN of your device, without a password.
account.passkeys-unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
account.oidc-none: Not linked. Link your account once, then you can sign in with it.
account.oidc-linked: Single sign-on is linked to this account.
users.title: Users and roles
users.name: User name
users.reset-confirm: Remove the authenticator app, all passkeys and single sign-on links of {name}?
users.role-new: New role or change a role
users.role-name-hint: a-z, 0-9 and -, starting with a letter. An existing name changes that role.
error.network: The panel server does not answer.
error.invalid-credentials: User name or password is wrong.
error.locked: Too many failed sign-ins. The account is locked for 15 minutes.
error.rate-limited: Too many attempts from this address. Wait a minute.
error.ticket-expired: That took too long. Please start again.
error.invalid-code: The code is wrong or was used already.
error.passkeys-need-host-name: Passkeys need a host name such as localhost, not an IP address. Open the panel by its name.
error.too-many-passkeys: An account can have at most 16 passkeys.
error.weak-password: The password breaks a rule: 12 to 256 characters, not the user name.
error.setup-done: The first account exists already. Please sign in.
error.invalid-setup-token: The setup token is wrong, used or expired. Run "api token setup" in the console of the node for a new one.
error.user-exists: A user with this name exists.
error.last-owner: At least one enabled user must keep the owner role.
error.role-above-own-rights: You can only give rights you hold yourself.
error.user-above-own-rights: You cannot change a user with more rights than you.
error.invalid-name: Names are 1 to 32 characters: letters, digits, _ . and -.
error.invalid-role: Role names are 1 to 32 characters: a-z, 0-9 and -, starting with a letter.
error.csrf: The page is out of date. Please reload it.
error.origin: The request did not come from this panel.
error.not-signed-in: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
error.missing-right: Your account lacks the right for this page.
error.storage-failed: The panel could not save the change.
error.oidc-state: The single sign-on took too long or was started in another browser. Please try again.
error.oidc-failed: The single sign-on provider did not confirm the account.
error.oidc-not-linked: This single sign-on account is not linked to a panel account. Sign in with your password and link it under My account.
error.oidc-linked-elsewhere: This single sign-on account is linked to another user.
error.oidc-unavailable: The single sign-on provider cannot be reached.
services.title: Services
services.caption: Services of this node
services.none: No services on this node yet. Start one from a task.
services.confirm-stop: Stop {id}? Players on it are moved or disconnected.
services.task-invalid: Enter the name of a task: letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
console.title: Console
console.lede: Lines the service prints from now on. Older output is in the service's log file.
console.command-invalid: Enter a command of up to 256 characters.
console.no-service: No valid service given. Open it from the list of services.
console.dropped: {count} lines were skipped because the connection was too slow.
files.title: Files
files.caption: Contents of {path}
files.name: Name
files.not-text: This file is not UTF-8 text. Download it instead.
files.too-large-to-edit: Files over 1 MiB open only as a download.
files.upload-hint: Up to 8 MiB. A file with the same name is replaced.
error.invalid-path: This name or path is not allowed: no \ / : * ? " < > |, no . or .. and no dot or space at the end.
error.no-such-service: This service has no folder on this node.
error.no-such-folder: This folder does not exist (any more).
error.no-such-file: This file does not exist (any more).
error.file-too-large: The file is larger than 8 MiB; copy it from the node directly.
error.body-too-large: The file is larger than 8 MiB.
error.busy: Other uploads are running. Try again in a moment.
error.is-folder: A folder already has this name.
error.is-file: A file has the name of a folder in this path.
error.folder-not-empty: Only empty folders can be deleted.
error.link-refused: Links are not followed in the file manager.
error.missing-scope: Your role does not allow this.
players.title: Players
players.caption: {count} players online
players.name: Name
players.text-hint: Sent as a private message from the console of {service}. At most 256 characters, one line.
players.reason-hint: Runs on {service}, the server the player is on. The ban is that server's own ban list. At most 256 characters, one line.
config.title: Configuration
config.lede: Groups and tasks are checked by the node exactly like the files and the console: a wrong value is refused with the field it concerns. If someone else saved in between, saving is refused; open the document again.
config.document-hint: JSON with the same fields as the YAML file.
config.templates-lede: Text files of the templates in local/templates. Running services pick a change up at their next start.
config.transfer-lede: The archive holds cloud.yml, nodes.yml, groups, tasks and the other files of config/, never secrets.
config.import-hint: A zip from an export, at most 8 MiB. Nothing is written before you confirm the preview.
config.no-changes: The archive matches the current configuration.
error.invalid-text: At most 256 characters, one line, no control characters.
error.no-such-player: This player is not online any more.
error.player-between-servers: The player is switching servers. Try again in a moment.
error.unusual-name: This name cannot be used in a console command.
error.service-not-running: The player's server does not take commands right now.
error.preview-required: Preview this archive again and confirm that preview.
error.precondition-failed: Someone else saved this in the meantime. Open it again to see the current state.
error.precondition-required: Open the document first, then save.
error.managed-by-head: On a cluster member the templates come from the head; change them there.
activity.title: Activity
activity.statistics-lede: Logins, playtime and the highest number of players at once, per game mode, as the node counts them under its privacy settings.
activity.no-statistics: No statistics yet. They appear once players have joined, provided statistics are switched on in privacy.yml.
activity.audit-lede: Sign-ins, changes to accounts and rights, and every action taken in the panel, newest first (the last 500).
activity.filter: Filter by event, user, target or address
activity.logs-lede: Searches the node's log files, newest first. Every search is written to the audit log.
activity.search-invalid: Enter 2 to 200 characters without line breaks.
activity.hits-truncated: {count} matching lines, more exist. Narrow the search to see the rest.
